description: Header file defining the StackwalkerARM class for ARM-specific stack walking, including methods for retrieving call frames using ARM register context, frame pointers, and stack scanning.

classes.name: StackwalkerARM
classes.description: ARM-specific implementation of stack walking, providing methods to retrieve call frames based on ARM register context and stack conventions.

methods.name: StackwalkerARM
methods.description: Constructor initializing ARM stack walker with system info, ARM context, frame pointer register, memory region, code modules, and symbolizer.

methods.name: SetContextFrameValidity
methods.description: Sets the validity mask for the context frame, mainly for unit testing purposes.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the current context frame based on ARM register context.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the caller's stack frame using various methods, including CFI info, frame pointer, or stack scanning.

methods.name: GetCallerByCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Constructs caller frame using CFI (Call Frame Information) records.

methods.name: GetCallerByFramePointer
methods.description: Constructs caller frame using the frame pointer register.

methods.name: GetCallerByStackScan
methods.description: Scans the stack to find plausible return addresses for caller frame.
